name: Perplexity · research/search assistant
scope: Perplexity Pro Search and Research on web, paid Pro access; excludes Computer and asset-building modes.
summary: Cited search expands into a conversational investigation and a structured report.
limitation: Source links enable checking; research synthesis is less constrained than editable study-by-study extraction.

centerEvidence.claim: A source-linked answer with conversational follow-up sits right of center, between execution and inquiry.

sources.title: What is Pro Search?
sources.finding: Source-linked synthesis, content-type focus, retained conversational context, and follow-up refinement.

sources.title: What is Research mode?
sources.finding: Iterative searching and revised research plans lead to an exportable report; Free limits and Pro access differ.

sources.title: Advanced Deep Research
sources.finding: Uploaded documents, calculations, live follow-up questions, progress, and editable reports.

N.claim: Follow-up steering and editable reports provide bounded control, without a field-level extraction protocol.

NE.claim: Document-based research can be steered during generation and inspected in the resulting report.

E.claim: Source links and selected content types provide traceability, not exact preservation.

SE.claim: Follow-up investigation retains source context while surfacing further evidence.

S.claim: Research revises its search plan as findings change; proposals concern the inquiry.

SW.claim: Revised investigation paths introduce limited research framing, not broad creative concepts.

W.claim: Synthesized reports and analytical framing add bounded novelty to retrieved material.

NW.claim: Prompted analysis and report refinement create a limited new research artifact.

name: NotebookLM / Gemini Notebook · source-centered research
scope: Standalone web notebook: selected-source chat and Studio reports; base access with plan-dependent limits. Experimental agentic actions excluded.
summary: A reading set becomes a grounded conversation and a family of source-derived formats.
limitation: Source grounding does not guarantee interpretation; experimental code and file agents are outside this profile.

centerEvidence.claim: Reading and briefing a chosen source set puts the default right and modestly above center.

sources.title: Learn about Gemini Notebook
sources.finding: Selected-source questions, citations, and study-oriented transformations define the core notebook.

sources.title: Use chat in Gemini Notebook
sources.finding: Select sources, inspect quoted passages, set response style and length. Creative continuations may be declined; new agentic functions are experimental.

sources.title: Generate reports in Gemini Notebook
sources.finding: Reports offer suggested formats, templates, editable generation settings, and embedded learning artifacts.

N.claim: Source, style, and length controls direct inspectable responses; no precise local editing contract.

NE.claim: Selected-source answers retain navigable citations while following response instructions.

E.claim: Source restriction and quoted passages support traceable reading, short of exact output preservation.

SE.claim: Brainstorming stays tied to the selected material; suggestions have a narrow evidentiary base.

S.claim: Suggested report formats and learning artifacts offer nearby presentation directions.

SW.claim: Suggested learning formats introduce limited new framing rather than independent creative strategies.

W.claim: Study formats reorganize content; closed-source chat limits substantive invention.

NW.claim: Customized reports vary structure within a supplied reading set.

adjustments.reason: Tighten the source-grounded proposal corner to emphasize prepared reading formats over open investigative planning.

name: ChatGPT Deep Research · research mode
scope: ChatGPT Deep Research with web, uploaded files and supported read-only apps; plan, region and permissions govern access.
summary: An editable research plan becomes a cited report, with source boundaries you can steer.
limitation: Citations do not enforce exact preservation; connected research uses read actions, not external execution.

centerEvidence.claim: The representative task is a user-directed, documented investigation over chosen evidence.

sources.title: Deep research in ChatGPT
sources.finding: Users edit proposed plans, restrict sites, interrupt research, and inspect cited reports and activity history.

N.claim: Editable plans, interruptions and source restrictions constrain research with visible progress.

NE.claim: A user-edited plan can operate on restricted sites or files and return checkable citations.

E.claim: Restricted source domains, uploaded files, citations and history support auditable synthesis.

SE.claim: The proposed plan develops an inquiry within specified evidence boundaries.

S.claim: It proposes a research plan and accepts refinement; this is research direction, not design authorship.

SW.claim: Planning new inquiry steps supplies limited original framing within a report task.

W.claim: Analytical synthesis and a newly composed investigation plan offer modest substantive novelty.

NW.claim: Outcome and report constraints guide composition of a new research artifact.

name: Claude Research · research mode
scope: Paid Claude Research on web or desktop with web search enabled; optional authorized remote connectors. Excludes mobile connector claims.
summary: An open question branches into successive searches and evidence-informed avenues.
limitation: Research chooses its next searches; no documented field-level extraction or exact plan-execution contract.

centerEvidence.claim: An open question delegates choice of investigative angles, placing the default modestly below the axis.

sources.title: Use research on Claude
sources.finding: Successive searches investigate different angles; paid web/desktop research can use connected tools.

sources.title: Enable and use web search
sources.finding: Search responses cite sources, may quote passages, and support fetching specified URLs.

N.claim: Prompts steer a research question, but the mode chooses many subsequent investigative moves.

NE.claim: A specified source URL can be analyzed with checkable source-linked responses.

E.claim: Cited responses and direct page retrieval offer traceability without exact preservation.

SE.claim: Connected context and successive searches ground the choice of further angles.

S.claim: The mode explicitly explores different angles and chooses subsequent inquiries.

SW.claim: Developing new angles adds bounded research framing rather than unrestricted invention.

W.claim: Novel analysis is inferred from investigation across angles, within an evidence-oriented mode.

NW.claim: A specified question prompts composed synthesis, with coarse production control.

adjustments.reason: Separate an open-question investigation slightly from plan-first report workflows.

name: Gemini Deep Research · research mode
scope: Gemini Apps Deep Research with Thinking or paid Pro; selected Search, uploads and eligible Workspace sources. Ultra-only inline visuals excluded.
summary: A reviewable search plan draws together selected sources and develops a broader account.
limitation: Source selection and editable plans guide research; exact preservation and local production precision are not promised.

centerEvidence.claim: A planned investigation synthesizes selected evidence, balancing delegated inquiry and user-defined production.

sources.title: Use Deep Research in Gemini Apps
sources.finding: Choose evidence channels, disable Search, edit the plan, and export reports; tiers govern models and limits.

sources.title: Gemini Deep Research overview
sources.finding: Research plans, iterative investigation, comparison and synthesis; reports can become prompted Canvas visualizations.

N.claim: Source selection and pre-run plan editing give explicit control over bounded research.

NE.claim: A revised plan can run over selected files and Workspace sources with Search disabled.

E.claim: Source selection and comparative source-based reports support grounded synthesis, not verbatim preservation.

SE.claim: Selected evidence informs a revisable multi-part investigation.

S.claim: Planning and iterative inquiry develop research paths across comparison tasks.

SW.claim: New investigation structures and concept relationships support bounded analytical proposals.

W.claim: Composed analysis and report-derived visual explanations add bounded novelty.

NW.claim: A prompted visualization can restructure an existing research report.

adjustments.reason: Keep the production-invention corner restrained: report visualization remains downstream of evidence synthesis.

name: Elicit · structured research workflows
scope: Elicit Pro systematic review, search, extraction and reports; excludes Enterprise-scale limits and Scale-only figure extraction.
summary: Evidence is organized into editable study fields, with room to refine the research protocol.
limitation: Audit generated screening and extraction decisions; a structured workflow is not comprehensive literature coverage.

centerEvidence.claim: Comparing user-specified study fields is evidence-heavy bounded production.

sources.title: Elicit systematic literature reviews
sources.finding: Editable criteria, quote-supported screening and extraction, protocol refinement, and cited synthesis are documented.

sources.title: Elicit pricing
sources.finding: Pro includes custom extraction, systematic review workflows, report templates, explanations, and exports; tiers differ.

N.claim: Editable criteria and extraction fields give checkable, structured production control.

NE.claim: User-defined extraction and screening preserve inspectable supporting passages.

E.claim: Sentence-level citations and extraction quotes support close audit; generated judgments remain fallible.

SE.claim: Iterating criteria after inspecting papers combines source evidence with protocol revision.

S.claim: Question refinement, screening suggestions, and iterative protocol design propose bounded research directions.

SW.claim: Proposed criteria add limited research framing, not broad compositional invention.

W.claim: Reports synthesize existing studies; originality mainly concerns questions and templates.

NW.claim: Custom extraction templates shape a derived report within the structured review workflow.

adjustments.reason: Accentuate structured, quoted extraction beside conversational research; remains inside both cardinal limits.

name: Consensus · research-answer synthesis
scope: Consensus web Pro messages and Deep reviews, with plan-dependent access; paper search, uploads and library sources.
summary: A research question becomes cited comparisons, evidence tables and visible gaps.
limitation: Full-text coverage varies; gaps and agreement indicators describe the retrieved evidence, not all existing research.

centerEvidence.claim: The ordinary workflow answers a specified research question using filtered papers and comparisons.

sources.title: How to Search and Best Practices
sources.finding: Choose papers or corpus, apply criteria, request comparisons and tables, and refine through follow-ups.

sources.title: Consensus analysis, citations and visuals
sources.finding: Citations reveal supporting quotations; full-text use is marked. Tables and gap matrices expose supporting papers.

N.claim: Search criteria, output instructions and follow-ups provide structured, inspectable control.

NE.claim: Requested comparison tables combine specified analysis with inspectable evidence links.

E.claim: Quoted citation support and full-text indicators strengthen traceability without guaranteeing correct interpretation.

SE.claim: A gap matrix links suggested follow-up areas to underlying papers.

S.claim: Evidence gaps prompt new inquiry, with custom dimensions and further searches.

SW.claim: Suggested gap framing is limited novelty within literature analysis.

W.claim: Comparative tables and diagrams reorganize findings; their novelty remains source-bound.

NW.claim: Specified tables and comparisons reshape existing findings into a bounded artifact.

adjustments.reason: Emphasize the gap matrix as a bounded suggestion mechanism rather than full protocol design.

name: Scite · citation context
scope: Scite Basic web: Smart Citations, search, reports, collections and source-grounded Assistant. Excludes external MCP/API execution.
summary: Citation passages make a paper's reception inspectable, with synthesis close to the evidence.
limitation: Supporting or contrasting labels classify citation context; they do not establish that a finding is true.

centerEvidence.claim: Inspecting how a known paper is cited is strongly evidence-oriented bounded work.

sources.title: Scite features
sources.finding: Citation statements are classified; reports expose exact passages and filters. Collections monitor citations; Assistant provides linked synthesis.

sources.title: Scite pricing
sources.finding: Basic provides Assistant, Search, citation reports and collections; trial access is time-limited.

N.claim: Classification, section and date filters make a bounded citation inspection controllable.

NE.claim: Filtered reports retain exact citation passages for checking the selected result.

E.claim: Exact citing passages are inspectable, while classification remains model-generated.

SE.claim: Citation chaining and contrary passages suggest nearby lines of inquiry.

S.claim: Source-linked discovery offers research candidates, not developed creative strategies.

SW.claim: Research discovery reframes an inquiry narrowly; substantive new direction is limited.

W.claim: Assistant summaries add phrasing and synthesis around existing research.

NW.claim: A prompted, source-linked answer supplies narrow composition within a citation workflow.

adjustments.reason: Tighten proposal reach around citation chaining and contrary passages.

name: Semantic Scholar · scholarly discovery
scope: Free Semantic Scholar website: search, library, Research Feeds, TLDRs and supported Ask This Paper. API excluded.
summary: Paper discovery and short summaries keep the cloud close to existing literature.
limitation: TLDR and paper-question features have limited coverage; recommendations do not establish comprehensive discovery.

centerEvidence.claim: A library-driven search suggests further papers, remaining grounded with modest proposal behavior.

sources.title: Semantic Scholar product
sources.finding: Search filters, citation exports, library feeds, TLDRs, influence signals and supported paper questions guide discovery.

N.claim: Filters and library choices specify bounded retrieval and organization.

NE.claim: Filtered results and citation exports provide inspectable bibliographic output.

E.claim: Paper-linked answers show supporting statements; summaries remain interpretive.

SE.claim: Library ratings condition recommendations on a chosen reading set.

S.claim: Research Feeds suggest papers and related topics, rather than research strategies.

SW.claim: Recommended topics offer nearby discovery; substantive invention is minimal.

W.claim: Short summaries and topic definitions add compressed wording, not new compositions.

NW.claim: Paper questions produce narrow explanatory text around an existing document.

name: ResearchRabbit · visual discovery
scope: ResearchRabbit web Free search, seed collections and interactive maps; RR+ expands controls and scale. No generative report scope.
summary: Seed papers unfold into a network of connections and possible next readings.
limitation: Network recommendations remain close to indexed literature and chosen seeds; the tool does not author new research content.

centerEvidence.claim: Following seed-paper connections delegates next-reading suggestions, placing the default below and right.

sources.title: ResearchRabbit features
sources.finding: Interactive paper networks and recommendations adapt to exploration and organize reading topics.

sources.title: ResearchRabbit pricing
sources.finding: Free supplies seed-based search and collections; RR+ adds advanced controls and more seeds.

N.claim: Seed selection and collections direct a bounded discovery process.

NE.claim: Chosen seeds organize inspectable existing papers, with limited production control.

E.claim: Connections refer to existing literature; recommendation relevance remains inferred.

SE.claim: Adaptive recommendations extend selected papers into further reading candidates.

S.claim: Interactive maps suggest where to read next; no developed strategic alternatives are documented.

SW.claim: The scoped discovery workflow selects existing papers, so generative proposal reach is zero.

W.claim: The documented workflow retrieves and connects existing literature; no substantive authored output is scored.

NW.claim: Organization and maps concern existing records; no generative execution workflow is established.
